headline: Record revenue, then the *worst week since 2008*

description:
Nvidia (NVDA) fell about 12-14% on Friday, 20 Nov 2026, after Reuters reported - citing two people briefed on the matter - that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues at the company. Reuters said it could not establish which accounting practices are under review or when the inquiry began. A media report is not a charge, and no wrongdoing has been established.

The same week Nvidia reported Q3 fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year (17 Nov 2026). The stock lost about 23% in the week, its worst week since October 2008, and trades about 46% below its October record close.
